mapper.sql: id, student_name, grade_code, student_user_id, status, created_at, updated_at

where.if:
AND (
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_parent_student parent_student WHERE parent_student.student_id = edu_student.id AND parent_student.parent_user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND parent_student.status = 'ACTIVE')
OR
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = student_organization.organization_id WHERE student_organization.student_id = edu_student.id AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND organization_admin.user_id = #{query.currentUserId})
)

mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu_student WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_student (id, student_name, grade_code, student_user_id, status) VALUES (#{student.id}, #{student.studentName}, #{student.gradeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{student.studentUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{student.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE edu_student SET student_user_id = #{studentUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{studentId} AND student_user_id IS NULL
